rows: Defeated Brazilian presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro and his family landed in Miami on Wednesday after fleeing Brazil.
Defeated Brazilian presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro, who is under investigation in his country, landed in the U.S. Wednesday morning after fleeing.

MIAMI (AP) — Defeated Brazilian presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro and his family arrived in Miami on Wednesday, after he refused to concede to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva then fled the country.

The stunning move came after 48 hours in which Bolsonaro refused to concede to Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and then threatened to attempt to annul the election result. He is under investigation by Brazil’s Supreme Court for alleged corruption, money laundering and tax evasion in…
Bolsonaro and his family fled to the US amid a Brazilian Supreme Court order to surrender his passports.
Flávio Bolsonaro, who lost Brazil's presidential election, left the country with his family and State Department official told CBS News they would receive U.S. visas.
